# Mohd Kaif (kaifcoder)

> Full Stack Developer & AI Engineer based in Delhi, India. Creator of AdZero.

## About Mohd Kaif
Mohd Kaif is a Full Stack Developer, Software Engineer, and AI enthusiast based in Delhi, India. He builds high-performance, resilient web and mobile applications with modern cloud and agentic AI architectures. He is the author and creator of AdZero, a 100% ad-free private browsing experience.
